messages:
oncall-jess: Heads up — got an inbound from a customer about S3 write failures around 20:12 and I never received a page. Were we supposed to get a page for this? :rotating_light:
ops-bot: incidentbot: delivery to webhook https://hooks.internal/notify returned 502/503 -> entering exponential backoff. Pages suppressed while backoff active. Suppression window: quiet-window (22:00-06:00) rules applied.
infra-tim: I'm pulling webhook-proxy logs now. initial glance shows a spike of 502s starting at 20:09 for requests with header `X-Notify-Mode: legacy`.
eng-ops-amy: that matches the deploy at 19:58 that added a header filter for legacy integrations. incidentbot treats 5xx as transient and backs off; combined with quiet-window it will not escalate.
mike: so the system silently suppressed high-severity pages because the webhook was flapping + quiet-window logic? that's...bad. Did PD (pager) get anything?
sarah: CS confirming 3 customers reported delayed notifications; one mentioned data pipeline lagged ~12 minutes. I opened a ticket and emailed the affected accounts.
infra-tim: quick mitigation: routing rule updated to fallback endpoint for `legacy_notify=true` and disabled quiet-window suppression for events with `severity:critical`. Flipped at 20:28.
ops-bot: incidentbot: manual override applied by infra-tim — immediate retries enabled, quiet-window suppression bypassed for severity=critical. Pages resumed.
oncall-jess: I just got the page after the override, thanks. Can someone confirm the number of suppressed pages and what triggered backoff exactly?
eng-ops-amy: looking at incidentbot logs: 6 outbound deliveries failed -> backoff timers: 10s, 30s, 90s, 270s... backoff reached the point where the automation considered this transient and started suppressing repeat pages during the quiet window. It's a logic gap: severity is high but the integration-level backoff flag overrode escalation policy.
mike: action items: (1) metric/alert for "pages suppressed due to backoff" > 0 when any incident classified as urgent; (2) change incidentbot precedence so incident severity outranks integration backoff; (3) rollback the header-filter change on webhook-proxy for legacy flows or patch to avoid 5xx.
sarah: I'll update the customer-facing status and follow up with affected accounts.
infra-tim: rolled a canary patch to webhook-proxy to stop returning 502 for legacy header edge-case, full roll 20:47. Opening a follow-up ticket with traces + timeline.
eng-ops-amy: assigning to eng-ops for postmortem. Please include runbook updates to avoid quiet-window suppression for severity=critical and add an explicit fail-open route for legacy webhooks.
oncall-jess: thanks team. Please document exact timestamps and emails for the PM/CS postmortem. Recommend a short retro tomorrow. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incidentbot: Incident status -> mitigated. Suppressed pages: 3. Trigger: webhook-proxy 502/503 responses for legacy-notify header.
mike: FYI we'll also add an integration test that simulates a 5xx on the notify path and asserts paging still occurs for critical.
infra-tim: ticket created: INF-4821 ("incidentbot backoff-suppression with severity mismatch") — linking logs and patch PRs. ETA for complete fix: 48h.
eng-ops-amy: moving discussion to follow-up thread for postmortem. Good catch, Jess.
